inlines.text: Draw the following sets on the number line.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\bigcup_{k=1}^{5}\{-k,k\}&=\{-1,1\}\cup\{-2,2\}\cup\{-3,3\}\cup\{-4,4\}\cup\{-5,5\}\\\bigcup_{k=1}^{5}\{-k,k\}&=\{-5,-4,-3,-2,-1,1,2,3,4,5\}.\end{align*}$$
Mark these ten isolated points with filled dots. Zero is not included.

spec.description: Double-arrow number line labelled at integers −5 to 5, with isolated filled points at every labelled integer except zero.
spec.mathematics: Exactly the ten integers with 1≤|x|≤5; no solution intervals.
spec.answerVisibility: Solution only; the source question supplies no number-line scaffold.

answer.short:
$[0,\tfrac12)\cup[1,\tfrac32)\cup[2,\tfrac52)\cup[3,\tfrac72)\cup[4,\tfrac92)\cup[5,\tfrac{11}2)\cup[6,\tfrac{13}2)\cup[7,\tfrac{15}2)$

Draw each half-open interval with its left endpoint included.
answer.worked:
Substituting $k=0,1,\ldots,7$ gives eight intervals, each from $k$ to $k+\tfrac12$. The left endpoint is included and the right endpoint is excluded. Their union is
$$[0,\tfrac12)\cup[1,\tfrac32)\cup[2,\tfrac52)\cup[3,\tfrac72)\cup[4,\tfrac92)\cup[5,\tfrac{11}2)\cup[6,\tfrac{13}2)\cup[7,\tfrac{15}2).$$

spec.description: Eight separate half-unit intervals above a double-arrow axis, labelled at integers 0 through 7.
spec.mathematics: For each k=0,…,7, the segment starts closed at k and ends open at k+1/2.
